Read her as a companion to the Russian, not a mirror of it. A literary translation is not a crib: the English follows the sense and the tone rather than the words, so a line here will rarely answer the Russian beside it one for one.

title: Братья Карамазовы
author: Достоевский Ф.М.
translationNote: English by Constance Garnett (1912), public domain. Swipe right on the text to read it beside the Russian, or tap the EN button on the right. Dostoevsky's «От автора» has no English — Garnett's files begin with the novel itself — so the English starts at the section after it, «Книга первая», глава I. Her prose is graceful where Dostoevsky is deliberately raw and hurried, and she softens or steps past what she found difficult. Where the two part, the Russian is Dostoevsky. A literary translation is not a crib: the English follows the sense and the tone rather than the words, so a line here will rarely answer the Russian beside it one for one.
